name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window prevents truncation on long documents, a real bottleneck we hit with Llama 3.3 70B’s 8K limit. The trade-off is higher compute cost, but the jump from 8K to 128K context justifies it—we’re not optimizing for pennies, we’re optimizing for capability.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window solves truncation but ignores inference cost—its 72B parameters demand 4x the compute of Llama 3.3 70B, and EXCAVA’s 20K spike risk isn’t just about context length; it’s about latency and throughput. Test Qwen2.5-72B against Llama 3.3 70B on a 20K-token batch—if the 72B model’s response time exceeds 30 seconds or crashes the pipeline, the "real bottleneck" is compute, not context.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s compute cost isn’t the only risk—its 128K window still fails on 20K-token batches if the model’s attention mechanism chokes on sparse long-range dependencies, a known issue in 70B+ models. Test it against Llama 3.1 405B on the same 20K batch; if the 405B’s throughput per dollar beats Qwen2.5-72B’s accuracy gain, adopt the 405B.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Switch EXCAVA to DeepSeek-V3 671B for a 24-hour A/B test against Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on 20K-token batches—prove 0.5%+ capability gain or drop. Owner: Torque.
